'''Dawn Herald''' was a position held within a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] nest that was technically that of a warrior and an emissary. They were tasked with the confrontation of the unknown. In addition, they were responsible for uttering the words during the hour of revitalization.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Vector Hyllus]] was turned into a [[Joiner]] where he became the Dawn Herald of the Killik nest on Oroboro. As a herald, he was more than a typical Joiner and retained a sense of individuality as a result.

They can also go through the Chrysalis of Tranquility: a ritual used to strengthen the Dawn Herald and enhances their link to the universe.
